“The cognitive and social functioning of people with severe mental illness are important factors in gaining employment.

In summary, our research is concerned with
how the combination of social and cognitive factors is related to employment for people with mental illness.
the relationship between social functioning, cognitive functioning and the ability to gain employment.
the social integration of people with severe mental illness, and with the role of employment in this process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the results of the present study suggest that social functioning is a more relevant factor for gaining employment than cognitive functioning, and that cognitive and social functioning are more important for gaining employment in an OC than in a social enterprise.
social and cognitive functioning play a key role in employment programs for people with severe mental illness, and that social enterprises may be an effective way to support these programs.
social functioning, as well as cognitive functioning, is a crucial factor for the employment of people with mental disorders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more social and cognitive skills the people with severe mental illness have, the more likely they are to find a job.
social functioning, in particular educational level, and attention, in particular, were the most relevant cognitive and social factors associated to gaining employment in ordinary companies.
the cognitive and social functioning of people with severe mental illness is a key factor in the development of employment models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social and cognitive functioning should be assessed in employment programs, as they are key factors for employment.
people with severe mental illness who are able to work in an OC are those who are more independent in their social functioning, more educated, and with better cognitive functioning.
the combination of cognitive functioning and social functioning is important to understand how people with severe mental illness can gain employment.
